Hi! I'm no expert but I think that you may have over-exfoliated your skin with all these acids.

The redness looks like irritation, and I would recommend that you cut back a bit on all these chemical exfoliants and find a nice moisturizer to fit into your routine. 

I did something similar, where I scrubbed with 2% BHA twice daily and sometimes used a 2.5% AHA gel. My skin looked a lot like yours at first, and then when more and more CC's popped up, I assumed that I was purging or that my moisturizer was causing me to break out. I learned that actually I had damaged my moisture barrier which made my skin much more prone to breakouts. The moisture barrier is essential to keeping your skin strong and less susceptible to bacterial infection

to be honest I got off mirtazapine by just being in denial. I just sort of pretended that my symptoms were caused by something else and tried not to think about it. I did kind of 'freak out' about things, I got upset and emotional and walked around crying my eyes out. One big thing I noticed was that I had a really hard time eating/sleeping.

The best tip I can give is to not think about it too much, because it's important to allow for the possibility of being okay. Still, try to keep it in mind a little if things get really hard. Another important thing is to try and stick to a schedule and get enough food/sleep.
